این یعنی مشکل از `Camera.viewPoint()` فعلی است، نه `CameraOrbit`.

### اصلاح پیشنهادی

باید Camera را بر اساس **جهت دید + Up vector ثابت WMVx** بسازیم، نه با فرمول فعلی screenX/screenY.

قبل از تغییر، فایل فعلی Camera را نگه دار:

```PowerShell
Copy-Item .\src\render\Camera.js .\src\render\Camera.backup.js
```

بعد این نسخه را جایگزین کن:

```PowerShell
@'
export class Camera {
  constructor({
    radius = 5,
    azimuth = 0,
    elevation = 0,
    axis = 'x',
    fitPadding = 0.78
  } = {}) {
    this.radius = Number(radius);
    this.azimuth = Number(azimuth);
    this.elevation = Number(elevation);
    this.axis = String(axis).toLowerCase();
    this.fitPadding = Number(fitPadding);

    if (!Number.isFinite(this.radius) || this.radius <= 0) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera radius: ${radius}`);
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(this.azimuth)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera azimuth: ${azimuth}`);
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(this.elevation) || this.elevation < -90 || this.elevation > 90) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera elevation: ${elevation}. Use -90 to 90.`);
    }

    if (!['x', 'y', 'z'].includes(this.axis)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera axis: ${axis}. Use x, y, or z.`);
    }
  }

  sphericalPosition(target = [0, 0, 0]) {
    const az = this.azimuth * Math.PI / 180;
    const el = this.elevation * Math.PI / 180;

    const ce = Math.cos(el);
    const se = Math.sin(el);
    const ca = Math.cos(az);
    const sa = Math.sin(az);

    if (this.axis === 'x') {
      return [
        target[0] + this.radius * se,
        target[1] + this.radius * ce * ca,
        target[2] + this.radius * ce * sa
      ];
    }

    if (this.axis === 'y') {
      return [
        target[0] + this.radius * ce * ca,
        target[1] + this.radius * se,
        target[2] + this.radius * ce * sa
      ];
    }

    return [
      target[0] + this.radius * ce * ca,
      target[1] + this.radius * ce * sa,
      target[2] + this.radius * se
    ];
  }

  viewPoint(point, center) {
    const v = [
      point[0] - center[0],
      point[1] - center[1],
      point[2] - center[2]
    ];

    const az = this.azimuth * Math.PI / 180;
    const el = this.elevation * Math.PI / 180;

    const ca = Math.cos(az);
    const sa = Math.sin(az);
    const ce = Math.cos(el);
    const se = Math.sin(el);

    /*
     * WMVx uses Z as the visual up axis after:
     *
     *   (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y)
     *
     * Keep the world-up direction fixed while orbiting.
     */

    let forward;
    let worldUp;

    if (this.axis === 'x') {
      forward = [
        se,
        ce * ca,
        ce * sa
      ];

      worldUp = [0, 0, 1];
    } else if (this.axis === 'y') {
      forward = [
        ce * ca,
        se,
        ce * sa
      ];

      worldUp = [0, 0, 1];
    } else {
      forward = [
        ce * ca,
        ce * sa,
        se
      ];

      worldUp = [0, 1, 0];
    }

    const dot = (a, b) =>
      a[0] * b[0] +
      a[1] * b[1] +
      a[2] * b[2];

    const cross = (a, b) => [
      a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
      a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
      a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]
    ];

    const normalize = a => {
      const length = Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]) || 1;
      return [
        a[0] / length,
        a[1] / length,
        a[2] / length
      ];
    };

    /*
     * Camera right vector.
     */
    let right = normalize(cross(forward, worldUp));

    /*
     * Camera up vector.
     */
    const up = normalize(cross(right, forward));

    const screenX = dot(v, right);
    const screenY = dot(v, up);
    const depth = dot(v, forward);

    return [screenX, screenY, depth];
  }

  project(positions, width, height) {
    if (!positions?.length) {
      throw new Error('Camera requires model positions');
    }

    let min = [Infinity, Infinity, Infinity];
    let max = [-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];

    for (const p of positions) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        min[k] = Math.min(min[k], p[k]);
        max[k] = Math.max(max[k], p[k]);
      }
    }

    const center = min.map((v, k) => (v + max[k]) * 0.5);

    const span =
      Math.max(
        max[0] - min[0],
        max[1] - min[1],
        max[2] - min[2]
      ) || 1;

    const view = positions.map(point =>
      this.viewPoint(point, center)
    );

    let minX = Infinity;
    let maxX = -Infinity;
    let minY = Infinity;
    let maxY = -Infinity;

    for (const p of view) {
      minX = Math.min(minX, p[0]);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, p[0]);
      minY = Math.min(minY, p[1]);
      maxY = Math.max(maxY, p[1]);
    }

    const scale = Math.min(
      (width * this.fitPadding) / Math.max(maxX - minX, 1e-6),
      (height * this.fitPadding) / Math.max(maxY - minY, 1e-6)
    );

    const cx = (minX + maxX) * 0.5;
    const cy = (minY + maxY) * 0.5;

    return view.map(p => [
      width * 0.5 + (p[0] - cx) * scale,
      height * 0.5 - (p[1] - cy) * scale,
      -p[2] / span
    ]);
  }
}

export default Camera;
'@ | Set-Content .\src\render\Camera.js
```

**ChatGPT:**

خروجی کاملاً مشخص کرد که نسخه‌ای که گذاشتیم اشتباه است. باید به تعریف واقعی WMVx برگردیم و فقط **Orbit را با Up ثابت Z** اصلاح کنیم.

الان `Camera.js` را به این نسخه تغییر بده:

```PowerShell
@'
export class Camera {
  constructor({
    radius = 5,
    azimuth = 0,
    elevation = 0,
    axis = 'x',
    fitPadding = 0.78
  } = {}) {
    this.radius = Number(radius);
    this.azimuth = Number(azimuth);
    this.elevation = Number(elevation);
    this.axis = String(axis).toLowerCase();
    this.fitPadding = Number(fitPadding);

    if (!Number.isFinite(this.radius) || this.radius <= 0)
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera radius: ${radius}`);

    if (!Number.isFinite(this.azimuth))
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera azimuth: ${azimuth}`);

    if (!Number.isFinite(this.elevation) || this.elevation < -90 || this.elevation > 90)
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera elevation: ${elevation}. Use -90 to 90.`);

    if (!['x', 'y', 'z'].includes(this.axis))
      throw new Error(`Invalid camera axis: ${axis}. Use x, y, or z.`);
  }

  sphericalPosition(target = [0, 0, 0]) {
    const az = this.azimuth * Math.PI / 180;
    const el = this.elevation * Math.PI / 180;

    const ca = Math.cos(az);
    const sa = Math.sin(az);
    const ce = Math.cos(el);
    const se = Math.sin(el);

    if (this.axis === 'x') {
      return [
        target[0] + this.radius * ce * ca,
        target[1] + this.radius * ce * sa,
        target[2] + this.radius * se
      ];
    }

    if (this.axis === 'y') {
      return [
        target[0] + this.radius * ce * ca,
        target[1] + this.radius * se,
        target[2] + this.radius * ce * sa
      ];
    }

    return [
      target[0] + this.radius * ce * ca,
      target[1] + this.radius * ce * sa,
      target[2] + this.radius * se
    ];
  }

  viewPoint(point, center) {
    const v = [
      point[0] - center[0],
      point[1] - center[1],
      point[2] - center[2]
    ];

    const az = this.azimuth * Math.PI / 180;
    const el = this.elevation * Math.PI / 180;

    const ca = Math.cos(az);
    const sa = Math.sin(az);
    const ce = Math.cos(el);
    const se = Math.sin(el);

    if (this.axis === 'x') {
      /*
       * WMVx coordinate system:
       * X = forward/back
       * Y = left/right
       * Z = up
       *
       * Orbit around world Z.
       */

      const forward = [
        ce * ca,
        ce * sa,
        se
      ];

      const right = [
        sa,
        -ca,
        0
      ];

      const up = [
        -se * ca,
        -se * sa,
        ce
      ];

      const screenX =
        v[0] * right[0] +
        v[1] * right[1] +
        v[2] * right[2];

      const screenY =
        v[0] * up[0] +
        v[1] * up[1] +
        v[2] * up[2];

      const depth =
        v[0] * forward[0] +
        v[1] * forward[1] +
        v[2] * forward[2];

      return [screenX, screenY, depth];
    }

    /*
     * Preserve the existing principal-axis behaviour
     * for Y and Z cameras.
     */

    if (this.axis === 'y') {
      const forward = [
        ce * ca,
        se,
        ce * sa
      ];

      const right = [
        sa,
        0,
        -ca
      ];

      const up = [
        -se * ca,
        ce,
        -se * sa
      ];

      return [
        v[0] * right[0] + v[1] * right[1] + v[2] * right[2],
        v[0] * up[0] + v[1] * up[1] + v[2] * up[2],
        v[0] * forward[0] + v[1] * forward[1] + v[2] * forward[2]
      ];
    }

    const forward = [
      ce * ca,
      ce * sa,
      se
    ];

    const right = [
      sa,
      -ca,
      0
    ];

    const up = [
      -se * ca,
      -se * sa,
      ce
    ];

    return [
      v[0] * right[0] + v[1] * right[1] + v[2] * right[2],
      v[0] * up[0] + v[1] * up[1] + v[2] * up[2],
      v[0] * forward[0] + v[1] * forward[1] + v[2] * forward[2]
    ];
  }

  project(positions, width, height) {
    if (!positions?.length)
      throw new Error('Camera requires model positions');

    let min = [Infinity, Infinity, Infinity];
    let max = [-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];

    for (const p of positions) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        min[k] = Math.min(min[k], p[k]);
        max[k] = Math.max(max[k], p[k]);
      }
    }

    const center = min.map((v, k) => (v + max[k]) * 0.5);

    const span =
      Math.max(
        max[0] - min[0],
        max[1] - min[1],
        max[2] - min[2]
      ) || 1;

    const view = positions.map(point =>
      this.viewPoint(point, center)
    );

    let minX = Infinity;
    let maxX = -Infinity;
    let minY = Infinity;
    let maxY = -Infinity;

    for (const p of view) {
      minX = Math.min(minX, p[0]);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, p[0]);
      minY = Math.min(minY, p[1]);
      maxY = Math.max(maxY, p[1]);
    }

    const scale = Math.min(
      (width * this.fitPadding) / Math.max(maxX - minX, 1e-6),
      (height * this.fitPadding) / Math.max(maxY - minY, 1e-6)
    );

    const cx = (minX + maxX) * 0.5;
    const cy = (minY + maxY) * 0.5;

    return view.map(p => [
      width * 0.5 + (p[0] - cx) * scale,
      height * 0.5 - (p[1] - cy) * scale,
      -p[2] / span
    ]);
  }
}

export default Camera;
'@ | Set-Content .\src\render\Camera.js
```

**ChatGPT:**

خوب، الان الگو کاملاً مشخص است. مشکل فقط **تعریف جهت yaw و مبنای Roll در Orbit** است.

برای `elevation=0` وضعیت فعلی:

```
yaw 0°   → Front + 90° CCW   ❌
yaw 90°  → Top               ❌
yaw 180° → Back + 90° CW     ❌
yaw 270° → Bottom            ❌
```

یعنی دوربین فعلی در محور X عملاً به‌جای چرخش حول محور عمودی WMVx، یک محور دیگر را به‌عنوان محور Orbit استفاده می‌کند.

نکته مهم: **دیگر نباید `Camera.js` را حدسی تغییر دهیم.** باید دقیقاً منطق Camera/Orbit خود WMVx را پیدا کنیم و همان را پیاده کنیم.

اول این جستجو را روی سورس WMVx اجرا کن:

```PowerShell
Get-ChildItem "C:\Users\ehsra\Documents\GitHub\WMVx\src" -Recurse -File |
    Select-String -Pattern "camera|orbit|yaw|azimuth|elevation|lookAt|yUpToZUp" |
    Select-Object Path,LineNumber,Line
```

اگر خروجی خیلی زیاد بود، این نسخه محدودتر:

```PowerShell
Get-ChildItem "C:\Users\ehsra\Documents\GitHub\WMVx\src" -Recurse -File |
    Select-String -Pattern "yUpToZUp|camera.*rotation|rotation.*camera|azimuth|elevation|lookAt|orbit" |
    Select-Object Path,LineNumber,Line
```

**خروجی را بفرست.** بعد بر اساس کد واقعی WMVx، فرمول Orbit را یک‌بار برای همیشه درست می‌کنیم.
